user.title: SisRUN
user.description: Use the same e-mail and password you use in the athlete app (the login your coach gave you). This integration only reads your training plan; it never writes anything to SisRUN.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to SisRUN again
reauth_confirm.description: SisRUN rejected the login for {email}. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: E-mail or password rejected by SisRUN.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach SisRUN (network down or the site changed).
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This SisRUN account is already configured.

data.weeks_ahead: Weeks ahead to fetch (0 = current week only)

load_history.name: Load history
load_history.description: Fetches past weeks from SisRUN and stores them in Home Assistant so the calendar shows older workouts. Each week is one request to SisRUN; 12 weeks take a few seconds.

weeks.name: Weeks
weeks.description: How many weeks back to fetch (1 to 52).

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: SisRUN account. If empty, applies to every configured account.
